Local spec pl-tc02-local.spec.ts 'TC-02 S29'. Hospital: seeded Alder 300101 and Birch 300102, read answered with h-day1-clean (Alder, Birch, Cedar). Judged 6/10. Held: Cedar auto-added; one 'Possible duplicates' sheet asks about Alder and Birch together; 'Different — add anyway' on Alder adds a second Alder; counts Alder 2 / Birch 1 / Cedar 1, no partial adds; activity: Alder shown + rejected, Birch shown with no outcome, no PHI. FAILED: (1) after a reload with the Birch question open, the question is gone and nothing says Birch was not added (Q15 accepts either; silently gone fails both); (2) Nursing Home (seeded Juniper with no DOB, Kale 1941-07-19; read Juniper / Kale / Larch): the review for Juniper shows ('Same or similar name without matching DOB or MRN'); after Back the app is on the Hospital list and the Nursing Home list shows no review and no message, and nothing of the scan was written: Larch (new) not created, Kale not put on Today's Visits (the whole Nursing Home scan waits for every review answer, useResidentListScan.ts confirmScan / submitScan); (3) known B24: no delete control for a resident (card or chart), so QA Kale cannot be removed and no patient_removed nursing_home row can exist. Recorded: no duplicate_prompt_shown row was written for the Juniper review although it was on screen (the page left within about a second).
Product issue: A duplicate question left open (reload, Back) is lost without a word: in Hospital that patient is not added; in Nursing Home the whole scan is discarded (new residents never created, known ones not put on Today's Visits). Nursing Home residents cannot be deleted (B24).

descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92580 How it works 4; TFA-92580 AC 7 · “It never silently drops or merges a patient, and existing patients' data is untouched.”. Mixed: stated part — answering 'different' adds the patient a second time; the Nursing Home removal is logged; our part — reload / going back with the duplicate question half-way (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug N38 · excluded (Its ticket is not ready for QA yet (not counted)) · was S1

A duplicate question left open is lost without a word: after a reload (Hospital) that patient is never added; pressing Back (Nursing Home) throws away the whole scan, so new residents are not created and known ones are not put on today

Tickets: TFA-92580 AC 5 (rejected by qa; Q15) · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (25acd727)

Note: TC-02/S29 (6/10); Nursing Home residents also cannot be deleted (B24).

Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S29 Duplicate prompt: answer one, leave one half-way and come back; Nursing Home removal; the logs

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 When a day-2 scan overlaps day 1, the app shows 'N patients are already on your list' with an 'add only the new ones' option. … (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 5; TFA-92580 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • T2 Silent, backend-only logging: every patient add tagged Scan or Manual, every patient removed or discharged, and every duplicate prompt as shown, accepted or rejected. … (TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 Analytics) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Local stack. Seeded before the agent starts: Hospital 401 QA Alder 71 Heart failure 300101 and 402 QA Birch 64 COPD exacerbation 300102; Nursing Home QA Juniper (no DOB on file, Cedar 10) and QA Kale 1941-07-19 Cedar 11 in All Residents

When Hospital: scan h-day1-clean.png and confirm. To the question about QA Alder answer that it is a different patient (add anyway). While the question about QA Birch is open, reload the page. Nursing Home: scan n-day1-clean.png and add; while the review for QA Juniper (name only) is open, go back. …

Then Hospital: QA Cedar is added, and QA Alder is added a second time because the physician said different. After the reload, the Birch question comes back, or the app says plainly that QA Birch was not added; it is never silently gone. Nursing Home: after going back, the Juniper review comes back, or the app says plainly that it was not added. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs on the checkpoints: after the reload, the Birch question or a 'not added' message; after going back, the Juniper review or a 'not added' message. Required backend checks: rounding:list holds QA Alder 2 times, QA Birch 1, QA Cedar 1, with no partial adds beyond the auto-add rows. patientActivityEvents for this run: the Alder prompt shown + rejected; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S29 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.
